name: Federated States of Micronesia
flagName: Flag of the Federated States of Micronesia
summary: Four white five-pointed stars arranged in a diamond on a light blue field. The stars represent the four states of the federation, and the blue the Pacific Ocean.
origin: The Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands, administered by the US, used a light blue flag with six white stars from 1965. When four of its districts formed the Federated States of Micronesia in 1979, they adopted a version with four stars.

colors.name: Light blue
colors.meaning: The Pacific Ocean; also the UN flag, under whose trusteeship the islands were administered.

symbols.name: Four stars
symbols.description: White stars arranged like the points of a compass.
symbols.meaning: The four states: Chuuk, Kosrae, Pohnpei and Yap.

history.label: Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands

facts: Its blue was inspired by the flag of the United Nations.
Its 10:19 ratio matches the US flag.
Palau and the Marshall Islands left the Trust Territory separately.
clues: Four white stars in a diamond on light blue.
Its stars stand for four island states.
Its predecessor had six stars for six districts.
